title: INQUIRY IN SCIENCE AND SCIENCE EDUCATION
description: Investigates inquiry and the nature of inquiry in science as it relates to science education. Examines issues relating to integrating scientific understandings and practice into K-12 instruction.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:20pm in FURM 404 - Joyce Collin Furman Hall 404 (9/23 to 12/4)
